title: Health and tech, from the lab to my bedside

steps.label: In the lab
steps.line: A cancer diagnostics lab, running itself
text: I'm also building an AI that scores breast cancer slides after chemo. Provisional patent filed 2026, in collaboration with MD Anderson Cancer Center.

steps.label: On me
steps.line: My own health, in one place
text: This page is that step. Above, my apps and the strap I hacked become one row per day.

steps.label: At the bedside
text: It syncs to my phone automatically and costs under $20 to make. I'm adding organic, cartoon-like motion so it feels like part of the room.

My Philips wake-up light gave a few hundred lux, and on paper the fold-out version reaches 10,000 lux at about 30 W. Next, the lamp could wake me in light sleep using the strap signal this page pulls out.
